mainContent.content: A jewelry study rooted in Putuo blessing symbolism. Ornament as portable prayer — small enough to wear daily, dense enough to carry cultural coordinates. The collection features gold line art with lotus, pagoda, and cloud motifs alongside jade pieces.

content.title: Six jewelry designs: gold lotus and pagoda line art, jade donut pendant, textured gold disc

mainContent.content: Six designs in gold and jade — lotus and pagoda motifs repeat with variation like mantra loops. Circular composition evokes completeness in Buddhist symbolism.
From decoration to devotion. Each piece carries narrative weight beyond material value. Gold line drawings translate traditional iconography into contemporary graphic form.
